rules.rule_name: Provider Directory Extract Initialization
rules.rule_description: The Provider Directory Extract program (PRVDIR01) initializes by opening the Provider Master File for reading and the Directory Output File for writing, and sets the directory row counter to zero before processing begins.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 1:Provider Directory Extract Initialization

acceptance_criteria.Given: The PRVDIR01 program is invoked to generate the Provider Directory extract
acceptance_criteria.When: The program starts execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Provider Master File (PRV-MASTER-FILE) is opened as the input source, the Directory Output File (DIR-OUT-FILE) is opened as the output destination, the end-of-file flag is set to 'N' (not reached), and the directory row count (WS-DIR-COUNT) is initialized to zero in preparation for sequential record processing

rules.rule_name: Sequential Provider Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: The program reads provider records one at a time, sequentially from the Provider Master File, advancing through each record in order until all records have been processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 2:Sequential Provider Record Retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Provider Master File (PRV-MASTER-FILE) is open and available for reading
acceptance_criteria.When: The program requests the next provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next sequential record is retrieved from the Provider Master File into the Provider Master Record (PRV-MASTER-RECORD), and the file status is captured in WS-FILE-STATUS for end-of-file evaluation

rules.rule_name: End-of-File Detection for Provider Master File
rules.rule_description: After each read attempt on the Provider Master File, the program checks whether all records have been processed. If the end of file is reached, processing stops and the program moves to completion reporting.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 2:Sequential Provider Record Retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: A read operation has been performed on the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The file status (WS-FILE-STATUS) indicates end-of-file (WS-FS-EOF is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-file flag (WS-END-OF-FILE) is set to TRUE, the record retrieval loop terminates, and control passes to the Directory Extract Completion Reporting step

rules.rule_name: Active Provider Filtering
rules.rule_description: Only providers whose status is marked as ACTIVE in the Provider Master Record are eligible for inclusion in the Provider Directory. Inactive or terminated providers are skipped entirely and no directory record is produced for them.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 3:Active Provider Filtering

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's active status indicator (PRV-ACTIVE of PRV-MASTER-RECORD) is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the provider status is ACTIVE, the record proceeds to Provider Directory Record Mapping; if the provider status is NOT ACTIVE (inactive or terminated), the record is skipped and the program immediately retrieves the next provider record without writing any output

rules.rule_name: Provider Directory Record Mapping
rules.rule_description: For each active provider, specific fields from the Provider Master Record are mapped to the corresponding fields in the Directory Output Record. The provider name is limited to the first 60 characters of the Variant field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 4:Provider Directory Record Mapping

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has passed the Active Provider Filter and is confirmed as ACTIVE
acceptance_criteria.When: The directory record is being prepared for output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following fields are mapped from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Output Record: Medicaid ID (PRV-MEDICAID-ID → DIR-MEDICAID-ID), National Provider Identifier (PRV-NPI → DIR-NPI), Provider Type Code (PRV-TYPE-CODE → DIR-TYPE), Risk Tier (PRV-RISK-TIER → DIR-RISK-TIER), and Provider Name set to the first 60 characters only of the Provider Variant field (PRV-VARIANT(1:60) → DIR-NAME)

rules.rule_name: Provider Name 60-Character Truncation Rule
rules.rule_description: The provider name written to the Directory Output is restricted to the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field. Any content beyond position 60 is excluded from the directory record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 4:Provider Directory Record Mapping

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record is being mapped to the Directory Output Record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Name field (DIR-NAME) is populated from the Provider Variant field (PRV-VARIANT)
acceptance_criteria.Then: Only the first 60 characters of PRV-VARIANT (positions 1 through 60) are moved to DIR-NAME; any characters beyond position 60 in PRV-VARIANT are not included in the directory output

rules.rule_name: Directory Record Output
rules.rule_description: After all required fields have been mapped, the fully populated Directory Output Record is written to the Directory Output File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 5:Directory Record Output

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Directory Output Record (DIR-OUT-RECORD) has been fully populated with the active provider's mapped fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Directory Output Record is written to the Directory Output File (DIR-OUT-FILE), making the active provider's information available in the provider directory extract

rules.rule_name: Active Provider Count Tracking
rules.rule_description: Each time an active provider record is successfully written to the Directory Output File, the directory row counter is incremented by one to maintain an accurate count of all directory records produced.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 6:Active Provider Count Tracking

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider's Directory Output Record has been successfully written to the Directory Output File
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The directory row counter (WS-DIR-COUNT) is incremented by 1, reflecting the cumulative total number of active provider records written to the directory extract

rules.rule_name: Directory Extract Completion Reporting
rules.rule_description: Upon processing all records in the Provider Master File, the program closes both files and reports the total number of directory records produced during the extract run.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 7:Directory Extract Completion Reporting

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end-of-file condition has been reached on the Provider Master File and all provider records have been evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The program completes its processing loop
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Provider Master File (PRV-MASTER-FILE) and the Directory Output File (DIR-OUT-FILE) are both closed, and the total directory row count is displayed in the format 'PRVDIR01: DIRECTORY ROWS=' followed by the value of WS-DIR-COUNT, after which the program terminates

key_functionalities.title: Provider Directory Extract Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Nightly Directory Extract\nPRVDIR01]) 
    B[Identify Program\nas PRVDIR01]
    C[Open Provider Master File\nas Input Source]
    D{Provider Master\nFile Available?}
    E[Open Provider Directory\nFlat File as Output]
    F{Provider Directory\nOutput File Ready?}
    G[Initialize Processing\nFlags for Extract Run]
    H([Proceed to\nProvider Record Retrieval])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D -->|Yes - File Accessible| E
    D -->|No - File Unavailable| Z([Halt Extract Process])

    F -->|Yes - File Ready| G

rules.rule_name: Identify Nightly Directory Extract Program
rules.rule_description: The nightly directory extract process must identify itself as program PRVDIR01 before any processing begins, establishing the program identity for tracking and reporting purposes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Identify Program as PRVDIR01

acceptance_criteria.Given: The nightly Provider Directory extract process is initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program identifies itself as PRVDIR01 so that all subsequent processing, logging, and reporting are attributed to this extract job

rules.rule_name: Open Provider Master File as Input Source
rules.rule_description: The Provider Master File must be successfully opened as the input data source before any provider records can be read and evaluated for inclusion in the Provider Directory.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Open Provider Master File as Input Source

acceptance_criteria.Given: The nightly Provider Directory extract process has identified itself as PRVDIR01
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Provider Master File as the input source
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Provider Master File is accessible and available, the file is opened successfully and the process proceeds to open the Provider Directory output file; if the Provider Master File is unavailable or cannot be accessed, the extract process is halted immediately and no directory output is produced

rules.rule_name: Open Provider Directory Flat File as Output Destination
rules.rule_description: The Provider Directory flat file must be successfully opened as the output destination before any provider directory records can be written. This file will receive all active provider records extracted from the Provider Master File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Open Provider Directory Flat File as Output

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Provider Master File has been successfully opened as the input source
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Provider Directory flat file as the output destination
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Provider Directory output file is ready and accessible, the file is opened successfully and the process proceeds to initialize processing flags; if the Provider Directory output file is unavailable or cannot be opened, the extract process is halted immediately and no directory output is produced

rules.rule_name: Initialize Processing Flags for Extract Run
rules.rule_description: Before reading any provider records, the extract process must initialize all processing control flags to their starting state to ensure the sequential read loop operates correctly from the first record through to the last.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize Processing Flags for Extract Run

acceptance_criteria.Given: Both the Provider Master File and the Provider Directory output file have been successfully opened
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initializes the processing flags for the extract run
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-file indicator is set to 'N' (Not Reached), signaling that provider records are available to be read, and the process proceeds to begin sequential retrieval of provider records from the Provider Master File

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Provider Record Retrieval After Successful Initialization
rules.rule_description: Once all initialization steps are complete — program identification, both files opened, and processing flags set — the extract process transitions to the provider record retrieval phase to begin evaluating provider records for directory inclusion.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed to Provider Record Retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has been identified as PRVDIR01, the Provider Master File is open as input, the Provider Directory flat file is open as output, and the end-of-file flag is initialized to 'N'
acceptance_criteria.When: All initialization steps complete successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: The process transitions to the provider record retrieval loop, where provider records will be read sequentially from the Provider Master File and evaluated for inclusion in the Provider Directory output

key_functionalities.title: Sequential Provider Record Retrieval
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Begin Sequential Record Retrieval])
    B[Read Next Provider Record\nfrom Provider Master File]
    C{End of File\nReached?}
    D[Pass Record for\nActive Provider Filtering]
    E([All Provider Records\nProcessed - Exit])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C -->|No - Record Available| D
    D --> B
    C -->|Yes - No More Records| E

rules.rule_name: Sequential Processing of All Provider Records
rules.rule_description: The system must read and process every provider record from the Provider Master File one at a time, in sequence, from the first record to the last, ensuring no provider record is skipped or processed out of order.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Next Provider Record from Provider Master File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Provider Master File is open and available for reading, and sequential record retrieval has been initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system requests the next provider record from the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves exactly one provider record at a time in the order they appear in the Provider Master File, and that record is made available for subsequent Active Provider filtering

rules.rule_name: End of File Detection to Halt Provider Record Processing
rules.rule_description: The system must detect when there are no more provider records remaining in the Provider Master File and stop the sequential retrieval process, ensuring all records have been evaluated exactly once.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of File Reached?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is sequentially reading provider records from the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: A read attempt is made and the Provider Master File signals that no more records are available (end of file condition is reached)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The sequential record retrieval process is terminated and the system exits the record processing loop, indicating that all provider records have been processed

rules.rule_name: Continue Processing When Provider Record Is Available
rules.rule_description: When a valid provider record is successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File (i.e., end of file has not been reached), the record must be passed forward for Active Provider status filtering to determine eligibility for directory inclusion.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Pass Record for Active Provider Filtering

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has just read a provider record from the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The read operation returns a valid provider record and the end of file condition has NOT been reached
acceptance_criteria.Then: The retrieved provider record is passed to the Active Provider filtering step for evaluation, and the system subsequently loops back to read the next provider record after filtering is complete

key_functionalities.title: Active Provider Filtering
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start: Evaluate Provider Record])
    B{Is Provider\nStatus\nActive?}
    C[Include Provider\nin Directory Extract]
    D[Exclude Provider\nfrom Directory\nNo Record Written]
    E([Return: Get Next\nProvider Record])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Active Status| C
    B -->|No - Inactive or\nTerminated Status| D
    C --> E
    D --> E

rules.rule_name: Active Provider Status Filter for Directory Inclusion
rules.rule_description: Evaluates each provider record from the Provider Master File to determine whether the provider holds an Active status. Only providers with an Active status are selected and written to the Provider Directory extract. Providers with any other status (inactive, terminated, etc.) are bypassed with no directory record produced.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Status Active?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been read from the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's status field is evaluated to determine if it is marked as Active
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the provider status is Active, the provider is included in the Directory extract and a directory record is written; if the provider status is not Active (inactive, terminated, or any other non-active status), the provider is excluded from the Directory extract and no directory record is written for that provider

    G([Directory Output Record\nFully Mapped & Ready])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G

rules.rule_name: Map Medicaid ID to Provider Directory Record
rules.rule_description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's Medicaid ID must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Map Medicaid ID
from Provider Master
to Directory Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and is being prepared for inclusion in the Provider Directory
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Medicaid ID from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Medicaid ID field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory reflects the provider's official Medicaid identifier

rules.rule_name: Map NPI to Provider Directory Record
rules.rule_description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's National Provider Identifier (NPI) must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Map NPI
National Provider Identifier
from Provider Master
to Directory Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID has already been mapped to the Directory output record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
acceptance_criteria.Then: The NPI (National Provider Identifier) from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the NPI field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory reflects the provider's federally assigned unique identifier

rules.rule_name: Map Provider Type Code to Provider Directory Record
rules.rule_description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's Type Code must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Map Provider Type Code
from Provider Master
to Directory Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID and NPI have already been mapped to the Directory output record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Provider Type Code from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Provider Type field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory correctly classifies the category or specialty of the provider

rules.rule_name: Map Risk Tier to Provider Directory Record
rules.rule_description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's Risk Tier must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Map Risk Tier
from Provider Master
to Directory Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID, NPI, and Provider Type Code have already been mapped to the Directory output record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Risk Tier from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Risk Tier field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory reflects the provider's assigned risk classification level

rules.rule_name: Map Provider Name (First 60 Characters) to Provider Directory Record
rules.rule_description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's name must be sourced from the Provider Variant field in the Provider Master record. Only the first 60 characters of this field are permitted in the Directory output — any characters beyond position 60 are excluded.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Map Provider Name
First 60 Characters Only
from Provider Master
to Directory Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID, NPI, Provider Type Code, and Risk Tier have already been mapped to the Directory output record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Name is being mapped from the Provider Master record to the Provider Directory output record
acceptance_criteria.Then: Only the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Provider Name field of the Provider Directory output record; any content beyond the 60th character position must be excluded from the directory entry

rules.rule_name: Assemble Provider Directory Output Record with All Mapped Provider Attributes
rules.rule_description: When writing an active provider to the nightly Provider Directory flat file, all required provider attributes must be mapped from the Provider Master Record into the corresponding Directory Output Record fields before the record is written.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Assemble Provider Directory Output Record with all mapped provider attributes

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File with the following attributes: Medicaid ID, NPI (National Provider Identifier), Provider Type Code, Risk Tier, and Provider Variant (Name)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system assembles the Provider Directory Output Record for the active provider
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must map: Provider Medicaid ID from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Medicaid ID field; Provider NPI from the Provider Master Record to the Directory NPI field; Provider Type Code from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Type field; Provider Risk Tier from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Risk Tier field; and the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Name field — all fields must be populated before the record is written

rules.rule_name: Provider Name Truncation to 60 Characters in Directory Output
rules.rule_description: The provider name written to the Provider Directory is restricted to the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field from the Provider Master Record. Any characters beyond position 60 are excluded from the directory output.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Assemble Provider Directory Output Record with all mapped provider attributes

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record exists in the Provider Master File with a Variant field that may contain more than 60 characters of provider name data
acceptance_criteria.When: The system maps the provider name to the Directory Output Record
acceptance_criteria.Then: Only the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field are written to the Directory Name field; any content beyond character position 60 is not included in the Provider Directory output record

rules.rule_name: Write Formatted Provider Record to Nightly Provider Directory Flat File for MCOs
rules.rule_description: Once all provider attributes have been assembled into the Directory Output Record, the fully populated record is written to the nightly Provider Directory flat file, which is consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Formatted Provider Record to Nightly Provider Directory Flat File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A fully assembled Provider Directory Output Record exists with all required fields populated: Medicaid ID, NPI, Provider Type Code, Risk Tier, and Provider Name (first 60 characters of Variant)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system writes the assembled record to the nightly Provider Directory flat file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The formatted provider record is successfully written to the nightly Provider Directory flat file (DIR-OUT-FILE) that is distributed to and consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs)

rules.rule_name: Increment Provider Directory Row Count Upon Successful Record Write
rules.rule_description: Each time an active provider record is successfully written to the Provider Directory flat file, the total directory row count is incremented by one to track the volume of records produced in the nightly run.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Formatted Provider Record to Nightly Provider Directory Flat File

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record has been successfully written to the nightly Provider Directory flat file
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation for the directory record completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Provider Directory row count is incremented by 1, accurately reflecting the cumulative number of provider records written to the directory during the current processing run

rules.rule_name: Active Provider Directory Count Tracking
rules.rule_description: Each time an active provider record is successfully written to the Provider Directory output file, a running total counter is incremented by 1 to track the total number of active providers included in the directory extract.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Increment Active Provider Count by 1

acceptance_criteria.Given: An active provider record from the Provider Master File has been successfully written to the Provider Directory output file
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation for the active provider directory row completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Active Provider Directory Row Count (WS-DIR-COUNT) is incremented by 1, reflecting the cumulative total of all active provider records written to the directory during the current extract run

rules.rule_name: Provider Directory Extract Completion Reporting
rules.rule_description: Upon completion of processing all provider records from the Provider Master File, the total number of active provider directory rows successfully written to the Directory Output File must be reported for reconciliation and audit purposes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Report Total Provider Directory Rows Written to Output File
PRVDIR01: DIRECTORY ROWS = WS-DIR-COUNT

acceptance_criteria.Given: All records in the Provider Master File have been read and evaluated, and the Directory Output File has been closed after writing all eligible active provider records
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Directory extract process reaches the end of all provider records and finalizes the output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must report the total count of provider directory rows written to the output file, displayed as 'PRVDIR01: DIRECTORY ROWS = [total count]', where the total count reflects only the active provider records that were successfully written to the Directory Output File

Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following fields are mapped from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Output Record: Medicaid ID (PRV-MEDICAID-ID → DIR-MEDICAID-ID), National Provider Identifier (PRV-NPI → DIR-NPI), Provider Type Code (PRV-TYPE-CODE → DIR-TYPE), Risk Tier (PRV-RISK-TIER → DIR-RISK-TIER), and Provider Name set to the first 60 characters only of the Provider Variant field (PRV-VARIANT(1:60) → DIR-NAME)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Directory Record Mapping
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each active provider, specific fields from the Provider Master Record are mapped to the corresponding fields in the Directory Output Record. The provider name is limited to the first 60 characters of the Variant field.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record is being mapped to the Directory Output Record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Name field (DIR-NAME) is populated from the Provider Variant field (PRV-VARIANT)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only the first 60 characters of PRV-VARIANT (positions 1 through 60) are moved to DIR-NAME; any characters beyond position 60 in PRV-VARIANT are not included in the directory output

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Name 60-Character Truncation Rule
all_rules.Rule_Description: The provider name written to the Directory Output is restricted to the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field. Any content beyond position 60 is excluded from the directory record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Directory Output Record (DIR-OUT-RECORD) has been fully populated with the active provider's mapped fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Directory Output Record is written to the Directory Output File (DIR-OUT-FILE), making the active provider's information available in the provider directory extract

all_rules.Rule_Name: Directory Record Output
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all required fields have been mapped, the fully populated Directory Output Record is written to the Directory Output File.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider's Directory Output Record has been successfully written to the Directory Output File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation completes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The directory row counter (WS-DIR-COUNT) is incremented by 1, reflecting the cumulative total number of active provider records written to the directory extract

all_rules.Rule_Name: Active Provider Count Tracking
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time an active provider record is successfully written to the Directory Output File, the directory row counter is incremented by one to maintain an accurate count of all directory records produced.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end-of-file condition has been reached on the Provider Master File and all provider records have been evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program completes its processing loop
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Provider Master File (PRV-MASTER-FILE) and the Directory Output File (DIR-OUT-FILE) are both closed, and the total directory row count is displayed in the format 'PRVDIR01: DIRECTORY ROWS=' followed by the value of WS-DIR-COUNT, after which the program terminates

all_rules.Rule_Name: Directory Extract Completion Reporting
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon processing all records in the Provider Master File, the program closes both files and reports the total number of directory records produced during the extract run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The nightly Provider Directory extract process is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program begins execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program identifies itself as PRVDIR01 so that all subsequent processing, logging, and reporting are attributed to this extract job

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify Nightly Directory Extract Program
all_rules.Rule_Description: The nightly directory extract process must identify itself as program PRVDIR01 before any processing begins, establishing the program identity for tracking and reporting purposes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The nightly Provider Directory extract process has identified itself as PRVDIR01
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Provider Master File as the input source
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Provider Master File is accessible and available, the file is opened successfully and the process proceeds to open the Provider Directory output file; if the Provider Master File is unavailable or cannot be accessed, the extract process is halted immediately and no directory output is produced

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Provider Master File as Input Source
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Provider Master File must be successfully opened as the input data source before any provider records can be read and evaluated for inclusion in the Provider Directory.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Master File has been successfully opened as the input source
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Provider Directory flat file as the output destination
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Provider Directory output file is ready and accessible, the file is opened successfully and the process proceeds to initialize processing flags; if the Provider Directory output file is unavailable or cannot be opened, the extract process is halted immediately and no directory output is produced

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Provider Directory Flat File as Output Destination
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Provider Directory flat file must be successfully opened as the output destination before any provider directory records can be written. This file will receive all active provider records extracted from the Provider Master File.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Both the Provider Master File and the Provider Directory output file have been successfully opened
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program initializes the processing flags for the extract run
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The end-of-file indicator is set to 'N' (Not Reached), signaling that provider records are available to be read, and the process proceeds to begin sequential retrieval of provider records from the Provider Master File

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Processing Flags for Extract Run
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before reading any provider records, the extract process must initialize all processing control flags to their starting state to ensure the sequential read loop operates correctly from the first record through to the last.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has been identified as PRVDIR01, the Provider Master File is open as input, the Provider Directory flat file is open as output, and the end-of-file flag is initialized to 'N'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: All initialization steps complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The process transitions to the provider record retrieval loop, where provider records will be read sequentially from the Provider Master File and evaluated for inclusion in the Provider Directory output

all_rules.Rule_Name: Proceed to Provider Record Retrieval After Successful Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once all initialization steps are complete — program identification, both files opened, and processing flags set — the extract process transitions to the provider record retrieval phase to begin evaluating provider records for directory inclusion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Master File is open and available for reading, and sequential record retrieval has been initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system requests the next provider record from the Provider Master File
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves exactly one provider record at a time in the order they appear in the Provider Master File, and that record is made available for subsequent Active Provider filtering

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Processing of All Provider Records
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must read and process every provider record from the Provider Master File one at a time, in sequence, from the first record to the last, ensuring no provider record is skipped or processed out of order.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system is sequentially reading provider records from the Provider Master File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A read attempt is made and the Provider Master File signals that no more records are available (end of file condition is reached)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The sequential record retrieval process is terminated and the system exits the record processing loop, indicating that all provider records have been processed

all_rules.Rule_Name: End of File Detection to Halt Provider Record Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must detect when there are no more provider records remaining in the Provider Master File and stop the sequential retrieval process, ensuring all records have been evaluated exactly once.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has just read a provider record from the Provider Master File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The read operation returns a valid provider record and the end of file condition has NOT been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The retrieved provider record is passed to the Active Provider filtering step for evaluation, and the system subsequently loops back to read the next provider record after filtering is complete

all_rules.Rule_Name: Continue Processing When Provider Record Is Available
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid provider record is successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File (i.e., end of file has not been reached), the record must be passed forward for Active Provider status filtering to determine eligibility for directory inclusion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been read from the Provider Master File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's status field is evaluated to determine if it is marked as Active
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the provider status is Active, the provider is included in the Directory extract and a directory record is written; if the provider status is not Active (inactive, terminated, or any other non-active status), the provider is excluded from the Directory extract and no directory record is written for that provider

all_rules.Rule_Name: Active Provider Status Filter for Directory Inclusion
all_rules.Rule_Description: Evaluates each provider record from the Provider Master File to determine whether the provider holds an Active status. Only providers with an Active status are selected and written to the Provider Directory extract. Providers with any other status (inactive, terminated, etc.) are bypassed with no directory record produced.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and is being prepared for inclusion in the Provider Directory
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Medicaid ID from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Medicaid ID field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory reflects the provider's official Medicaid identifier

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Medicaid ID to Provider Directory Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's Medicaid ID must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID has already been mapped to the Directory output record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The NPI (National Provider Identifier) from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the NPI field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory reflects the provider's federally assigned unique identifier

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map NPI to Provider Directory Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's National Provider Identifier (NPI) must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID and NPI have already been mapped to the Directory output record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Provider Type Code from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Provider Type field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory correctly classifies the category or specialty of the provider

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Provider Type Code to Provider Directory Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's Type Code must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID, NPI, and Provider Type Code have already been mapped to the Directory output record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Directory output record is being assembled for the active provider
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Risk Tier from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Risk Tier field of the Provider Directory output record, ensuring the directory reflects the provider's assigned risk classification level

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Risk Tier to Provider Directory Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's Risk Tier must be sourced from the Provider Master record and placed into the corresponding field of the Directory output record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File and the Medicaid ID, NPI, Provider Type Code, and Risk Tier have already been mapped to the Directory output record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Name is being mapped from the Provider Master record to the Provider Directory output record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field from the Provider Master record must be mapped to the Provider Name field of the Provider Directory output record; any content beyond the 60th character position must be excluded from the directory entry

all_rules.Rule_Name: Map Provider Name (First 60 Characters) to Provider Directory Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each active provider being written to the Provider Directory, the provider's name must be sourced from the Provider Variant field in the Provider Master record. Only the first 60 characters of this field are permitted in the Directory output — any characters beyond position 60 are excluded.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been identified from the Provider Master File with the following attributes: Medicaid ID, NPI (National Provider Identifier), Provider Type Code, Risk Tier, and Provider Variant (Name)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system assembles the Provider Directory Output Record for the active provider
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must map: Provider Medicaid ID from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Medicaid ID field; Provider NPI from the Provider Master Record to the Directory NPI field; Provider Type Code from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Type field; Provider Risk Tier from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Risk Tier field; and the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field from the Provider Master Record to the Directory Name field — all fields must be populated before the record is written

all_rules.Rule_Name: Assemble Provider Directory Output Record with All Mapped Provider Attributes
all_rules.Rule_Description: When writing an active provider to the nightly Provider Directory flat file, all required provider attributes must be mapped from the Provider Master Record into the corresponding Directory Output Record fields before the record is written.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record exists in the Provider Master File with a Variant field that may contain more than 60 characters of provider name data
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system maps the provider name to the Directory Output Record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field are written to the Directory Name field; any content beyond character position 60 is not included in the Provider Directory output record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Name Truncation to 60 Characters in Directory Output
all_rules.Rule_Description: The provider name written to the Provider Directory is restricted to the first 60 characters of the Provider Variant field from the Provider Master Record. Any characters beyond position 60 are excluded from the directory output.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A fully assembled Provider Directory Output Record exists with all required fields populated: Medicaid ID, NPI, Provider Type Code, Risk Tier, and Provider Name (first 60 characters of Variant)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system writes the assembled record to the nightly Provider Directory flat file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted provider record is successfully written to the nightly Provider Directory flat file (DIR-OUT-FILE) that is distributed to and consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Formatted Provider Record to Nightly Provider Directory Flat File for MCOs
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once all provider attributes have been assembled into the Directory Output Record, the fully populated record is written to the nightly Provider Directory flat file, which is consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record has been successfully written to the nightly Provider Directory flat file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation for the directory record completes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Provider Directory row count is incremented by 1, accurately reflecting the cumulative number of provider records written to the directory during the current processing run

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Provider Directory Row Count Upon Successful Record Write
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time an active provider record is successfully written to the Provider Directory flat file, the total directory row count is incremented by one to track the volume of records produced in the nightly run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An active provider record from the Provider Master File has been successfully written to the Provider Directory output file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation for the active provider directory row completes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Active Provider Directory Row Count (WS-DIR-COUNT) is incremented by 1, reflecting the cumulative total of all active provider records written to the directory during the current extract run

all_rules.Rule_Name: Active Provider Directory Count Tracking
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each time an active provider record is successfully written to the Provider Directory output file, a running total counter is incremented by 1 to track the total number of active providers included in the directory extract.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All records in the Provider Master File have been read and evaluated, and the Directory Output File has been closed after writing all eligible active provider records
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Directory extract process reaches the end of all provider records and finalizes the output
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must report the total count of provider directory rows written to the output file, displayed as 'PRVDIR01: DIRECTORY ROWS = [total count]', where the total count reflects only the active provider records that were successfully written to the Directory Output File

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Directory Extract Completion Reporting
all_rules.Rule_Description: Upon completion of processing all provider records from the Provider Master File, the total number of active provider directory rows successfully written to the Directory Output File must be reported for reconciliation and audit purposes.

description:
PRVDIR01 is a batch program that reads the Provider Master indexed file and extracts all active providers to produce a nightly directory flat file consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs). For each active provider record, it writes key provider attributes — including Medicaid ID, NPI, provider type, risk tier, and name — to the output directory file, and reports the total count of directory rows written upon completion.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed), Sequential File - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Provider Directory Extract Initialization - Open the Provider Master file as input source and the Provider Directory flat file as output destination to begin the nightly directory extract process 2: Sequential Provider Record Retrieval - Read through all provider records in the Provider Master file sequentially, one record at a time, until all records have been processed 3: Active Provider Filtering - Evaluate each provider record and select only those providers whose status is marked as Active, excluding inactive or terminated providers from the directory 4: Provider Directory Record Mapping - For each active provider, map the following provider attributes to the directory output record: Medicaid ID, NPI (National Provider Identifier), Provider Type Code, Risk Tier, and Provider Name (first 60 characters) 5: Directory Record Output - Write the mapped active provider information as a formatted record to the nightly Provider Directory flat file that is consumed by Managed Care Organizations (MCOs) 6: Active Provider Count Tracking - Maintain a running count of all active provider records written to the directory file during the extract process 7: Directory Extract Completion Reporting - Upon processing all provider records, report the total number of provider directory rows written to the output file for reconciliation and audit purposes
